# simplemdm_assignmentgroup_custom_attribute_values (Data Source)

Lists custom attribute values assigned to an assignment group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "simplemdm_assignmentgroup_custom_attribute_values" "group" {
  assignment_group_id = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `assignment_group_id` (String) Required. ID of the assignment group.

### Read-Only

- `custom_attribute_values` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--custom_attribute_values))

<a id="nestedblock--custom_attribute_values"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_attribute_values`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Custom attribute name.
- `secret` (Boolean) Whether the attribute is marked as secret.
- `source` (String) Source of the value: 'device', 'group', or 'account'.
- `value` (String) Resolved attribute value.
